description: Speech-to-text for one audio or video file by URL, using Whisper (turbo) on a GPU. Returns the full transcript, timed segments, ready-made SRT and WebVTT captions, and the detected language; optional translation to English. Files up to 25 MB (about 25 minutes of typical MP3). Useful for captioning videos, indexing podcasts, or reading meetings. Not charged if the file can't be fetched or transcribed. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

language.description: Optional language code, e.g. 'en'. Detected if omitted.

translate.description: Also translate the speech to English.

url.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL of an audio or video file, up to 25 MB.

name: transcribe_audio
title: Transcribe audio or video
